messages:
alex chu: Quick check — candidate is confirmed for Mon 10am PT. calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/c/xyz
alex chu: Panel is: Rachel (system design), Samir (infra), Marie (evals). Can someone volunteer to own debrief notes + submit rubric within 24h? :eyes:
rachel ng: I can own notes. will take debrief lead and start the rubric doc afterwards.
marie k.: thanks! quick rubric Q — for collaboration do we use 1-5 or 1-7? last time we had mixed scoring.
samir patel: We standardized on 1-5 in the tracker but some interviewers still use 1-7. TL;DR: use 1-5 here and add a short justification field if you feel nuance is lost.
alex chu: great — add a single-sentence rationale in the "notes" box if you pick an extreme score.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: debrief form + template -> https://intra.redwood.ai/debriefs/template. Please submit within 24 hours or ping @people-ops for extensions.
marie k.: also can we add a 10 minute buffer after the interview for short sync? candidate might need 5-10 to sign off; want to avoid back-to-back.
rachel ng: yes, can move meeting to 10:10 end or reserve 10:10-10:20 as overflow. I'll update the calendar now.
alex chu: thanks all. action items:
- rachel: take debrief notes + submit rubric (1-5) within 24h
- rachel: add 10min buffer on calendar
- samir & marie: be ready for system/infra followups in feedback
- people-ops: if rachel needs extension, please escalate

alex chu: tagging candidate email in calendar and adding joining instructions (zoom + phone).
